--- stderr
gomad: invalid_input: flag: help requested
Usage of gomad explore:
  -__plan
    	create a campaign plan
  -artifacts string
    	artifact root (default ".gomad/artifacts")
  -build-tag value
    	validated Go build tag
  -capability-mode string
    	closure, linked, or guarded capability assessment (default "closure")
  -choice-bytes value
    	runtime choice trace capacity (default 8388608)
  -choice-start-ordinal uint
    	first replay-plan decision ordinal choice exploration expands; inspect --choices lists ordinals
  -choices
    	record bounded runtime choices
  -clock-tick string
    	virtual-clock tick policy: strict or forward (default "strict")
  -corpus string
    	guided coverage corpus directory
  -count uint
    	explore seeds 0 through N-1
  -coverage string
    	none, semantic, choice, or semantic+choice (default "none")
  -diagnostics
    	record runtime-state diagnostics; implies --choices
  -env value
    	target NAME=VALUE
  -execution-timeout duration
    	per-execution host deadline (default 30s)
  -failure-budget uint
    	distinct failure signature threshold (default 1)
  -guide
    	exclude answered seeds using a bounded coverage corpus
  -guide-regression
    	re-run corpus seeds with --guide; fully answered default requests execute zero seeds and exit 0
  -io-ro-mount value
    	read-only HOST_DIRECTORY=TARGET_DIRECTORY mapping
  -io-transcript-bytes value
    	I/O transcript capacity (64MiB to 1GiB, whole MiB) (default 67108864)
  -json
    	emit stable JSON events
  -keep-successes string
    	none, novel, or all (default "none")
  -max-choice-depth uint
    	maximum forced choice decisions
  -max-crash-decisions uint
    	maximum crash-state decision ordinal
  -max-executions uint
    	maximum exploration candidates
  -max-exploration-bytes value
    	maximum live choice-exploration bytes
  -max-exploration-result-bytes value
    	maximum combined result bytes per candidate
  -max-fault-decisions uint
    	maximum fault decision ordinal
  -max-forced-decisions uint
    	maximum combined forced decisions
  -max-network-decisions uint
    	maximum network decision ordinal
  -max-runtime-decisions uint
    	maximum runtime decision ordinal
  -max-scenario-decisions uint
    	maximum scenario decision ordinal
  -max-storage-decisions uint
    	maximum storage decision ordinal
  -on-failure string
    	first, budget, or all (default "first")
  -output string
    	campaign plan output
  -output-limit value
    	retained bytes per output stream (default 8388608)
  -overall-timeout duration
    	complete exploration host deadline (default 10m0s)
  -parallel int
    	maximum active targets (default {{parallel}})
  -require-probe value
    	required semantic probe (requires --coverage=semantic)
  -seeds string
    	seed set or inclusive ranges (default "1")
  -strategy string
    	seed, choice-exploration, or simulation-exploration (default "seed")
  -success-bytes value
    	total retained successful-execution bytes
  -success-limit uint
    	maximum retained successful executions
  -terminate-grace duration
    	termination grace inside deadlines (default 2s)
  -toolchain-root string
    	absolute pinned toolchain root
  -working-dir string
    	absolute target module root (default: the current directory)
  -world-transition-limit value
    	World transition capacity (default 67108864)
